settings.heading: Order processing
settings.content: Orders are prepared before they are handed to the courier. Current processing information can be communicated during checkout, in an order confirmation, or through a direct order update from Kasya.

settings.heading: Metro Manila delivery
settings.content: Delivery timing depends on the courier, destination, and current order volume. Any available estimate will be communicated with your order or shipping update.

settings.heading: Provincial delivery
settings.content: Provincial delivery timing varies by destination and courier coverage. Any available estimate will be communicated with your order or shipping update.

settings.heading: Shipping fees
settings.content: Shipping costs ₱55–₱99 depending on location. The applicable amount is shown during checkout before you complete your order.

settings.heading: Free shipping
settings.content:
Enjoy free shipping on orders of ₱2,000 and up.

This is a current promotional offer and may be updated separately from Kasya’s permanent shipping policy.

settings.heading: Order tracking
settings.content: Tracking information is provided after an order has been prepared for delivery. Use the tracking details in your order update to follow the shipment on the courier’s tracking page.

settings.heading: Delivery delays
settings.content: Courier delays, weather disruptions, high-volume sale periods, and failed delivery attempts may affect delivery timing. Tracking scans can also take time to update. If you need help, contact Kasya with your order number and tracking details.

settings.heading: Need help?
settings.content: For questions about an order or delivery, visit Kasya’s Contact Details page and include your order number when available.

settings.title: Shipping Information
settings.introduction: Find information about order processing, delivery, shipping fees, tracking, and possible delays.
